game_concept: A racing platformer set in Snowy Hold – Sleigh Stables, the sleigh stables: the hold guard must handle winter bandits while practicing functions. Core idea – Scope Sanctuary: Distinguish local from global variables to keep hot soup pots safe from winter bandits.
theme: Snowy Hold – Sleigh Stables: the sleigh stables
core_gameplay_loop: In Sleigh Stables, repeat each round: Distinguish local from global variables to keep hot soup pots safe from winter bandits. Each round the rival advances, and solving the step moves the hold guard ahead. Then check the scope_safe value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Hint tokens that reveal one line of code
player_objective: Beat a rival AI to the chapel bell by solving code steps involving scope_safe that move the hold guard forward.
controls: Mouse/touch: drag code blocks into the editor panel; SPACE runs the code; keys 1-4 pick answers.
win_condition: Player progress reaches 100% before the rival does (rival speed 0.9).
lose_condition: The rival reaches the chapel bell first, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 6 – Functions | Level 9 (extended tier): Scope Sanctuary
assets_style: cozy pixel-art snow town: icy blue rooftops, frosted pines, warm lantern glow; flat Kenney-style sprites; soft bells, wind howls and cozy hearth crackle
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Scope Sanctuary' (Week 6 slot 7), mission type 'Rival Race', and setting 'Sleigh Stables'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Snowy Hold
region.mood: soft bells, wind howls and cozy hearth crackle

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how scope_safe changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against winter bandits in Sleigh Stables.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Player progress reaches 100% before the rival does (rival speed 0.9).
